body: @mkouba I think you already fixed a similar issue for the tests? Or was it @FroMage ?
Well, I think it was @stuartwdouglas in a232c70d13c17f335f0fb313e58ef3522443f8cf

It was about adding request scopes to tests. But for jobs, I'm not sure request scopes make a lot of sense. 

Well, actually you could totally argue that each job has its own request. I think it would actually make sense.

Hm, currently we don't activate the request context for a scheduled method invocation. I think we should. I'll send a PR.

@fandiluo  The easiest workaround is to annotate the method with `@ActivateRequestContext` .

> Well, actually you could totally argue that each job has its own request. I think it would actually make sense.

Exactly.

EntityManager doesn't work for Kotlin scheduler
